* [[Elizabeth II|Queen Elizabeth II]] addresses the House of Commons with her traditional [[Speech from the Throne]], outlining the [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour]] [[Her Majesty's Government|government]]'s legislative program for the 2008/09 [[parliamentary session]].
